video_title: Carmelo Anthony's Message to the Knicks Before Game 4 of the NBA Finals

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks must match the Spurs' physical intensity in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: whoever is the most physical team, but the smart physical team.
quotes.quote: The physicality of this series is whoever is the most physical team, but the smart physical team. Because now after a game like that, Game 3 back in New York, all eyes on it, the energy that's surrounding it, they are going to pay close attention to all the little things in the game. So don't be surprised if Game 4 comes out and the game is super tight. They are blowing the whistle, they are looking for certain things, because they study too.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs are learning and adjusting to the Knicks' physicality
quotes.excerpt: Once the whistle settles, now let's see. And I think Game 3 showed that a little bit.
quotes.quote: The first two games, they were trying to figure the shit out. They didn't understand how what was allowed against Shai, what wasn't allowed against Shai. Once the whistle settles, now let's see. And I think Game 3 showed that a little bit. The physicality when the game allowed the Spurs to be physical, they got big guards over there. Anybody that switches on JB is a big guard.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson needs to adjust his game to establish rhythm
quotes.excerpt: If he doesn't do that, the Knicks don't stand a chance.
quotes.quote: 82 points on 81 shots sounds crazy. But the reality of that, he has to do that. If he doesn't do that, the Knicks don't stand a chance. They just don't stand a chance. Now, you could do it, that's not really giving you no context of the 81 shots. When you're doing it in a Florida game, Game 1, Game 2, niggas was complaining about his shots. It was a different Florida game. Now you get back home, Game 3, make adjustments. Everybody make adjustments, the Spurs made adjustments. Those same shots that you were comfortable with in Game 1 and Game 2, they made the adjustment to that already in Game 3. So now, you got to make the adjustment. What's next? What's the next adjustment? Well, maybe getting off the ball a little bit earlier. Not saying give it completely up, but get off of it a little bit earlier. Get KAT going early.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns needs to be more aggressive in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: I would love to see KAT come out Game 4 and just duck in three, four times.
quotes.quote: I think it's a little bit of both. Was he aggressive enough? No. And again, when you're successful at something working a couple times, like KAT, it worked when he wasn't as aggressive last series and a little bit in Atlanta. So it worked. Now, we need you out the gate. I would love to see KAT come out Game 4 and just duck in three, four times early on, early post up, like putting niggas in the rim a couple times, get some fouls. I want to see that KAT in Game 4.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' bench must provide a 15-20 minute spark
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks bench, collectively. Like that's the 15 to 20 minute spark that you need.
quotes.quote: The Knicks bench, collectively. Like that's the 15 to 20 minute spark that you need. And if you can figure out a way how to make that adjustment to where you can get that 15 to 20 minutes out of your bench, that spark, that's the answer to that. When you got Clarkson and Jose and you are able to play KAT on that unit, OG with that unit, I would like to see Mikal with that unit, or Shamet with that unit. But I also like Shamet with that first unit.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks cannot play Mitchell Robinson and Wemby together
quotes.excerpt: You can't play Mitchell Robinson and Wemby together.
quotes.quote: You can't play Mitchell Robinson and Wemby together. You playing Mitchell Robinson and Kelden together. And it feels like, it feels like, you got to punish you got to punish them on the offensive glass standpoint. You have to. They had Wemby guard on KAT from like the first of the third quarter and then they go small on them. Like they put like a Castle or put a Vassel on KAT and have Wemby roam the room, you know what I mean? Like to to put the help defense. They put Wemby on Josh Hart in the corner.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' energy was too high in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes there's too much energy, though. And I think the Knicks felt too much energy yesterday.
quotes.quote: The energy was through the roof. Yeah, like the energy was there all day. Sometimes there's too much energy, though. And I think the Knicks felt too much energy yesterday. You know, you can it's just it was too much. Like if you ain't take time to really center yourself and like meditate and like get yourself together, that was a different type of energy to deal with.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson must reduce turnovers in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson can't have five turnovers.
quotes.quote: Turnovers got to be down. Jalen Brunson can't have five turnovers. KAT can't have one shot in the fourth quarter. Mitchell Bridges can't be playing like they was playing. Like they got to everything got to be clicking.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's left-handedness makes him difficult to defend
quotes.excerpt: He's a lefty for one. So most people that's guarding and defending him is righties.
quotes.quote: He's a lefty for one. So most people that's guarding and defending him is righties. So you unorthodox, you guard somebody unorthodox anyway. You used to sending somebody this way, which is they other hand, it's his strong hand. You used to send the righty left, that's his strong hand. You send him right, he going to bully you. You get what I'm saying? Like, he got counters for counters for counters for counters. A lot of people don't got that. Well, most people don't got that shit. Nobody got counters for counters for counters.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's left-handedness is a major advantage
quotes.excerpt: Him being lefty makes the two feet to his advantage. It fucks up the defender.
quotes.quote: Him being lefty makes the two feet to his advantage. It fucks up the defender. People want to guard righties, play off two feet. They ain't that efficient and effective like Jalen Brunson off two feet. So going left and jumping off two feet, I ain't got to shoot my right hand no more. I'm bumping you with the right shoulder and I'm shooting with the left.
